args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks in all production regions after the latest deploy, with an error rate of ~18%. Response: rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error in us-east but succeeded on retry. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 regression and the orchestrator rollout error before attempting a re-deploy.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions**: The first attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error in us-east, but the retry succeeded — all regions are now on v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate dropped to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**: It documents the v2.3.1 health-check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, the partial rollback failure/retry, and follow-up items (root-causing the v2.3.1 regression and the orchestrator error). The on-call engineer has been paged.
